=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:22139 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The `_pr_json_is_issue_implementation_pr` check uses `linked_pr_json`, which is only populated if the `target_pr` loop successfully fetched it in lines 21762-21764; an empty `target_pr` or a failed fetch leaves it empty.
  WHY: The reviewer says an empty `linked_pr_json` "could lead to incorrect resolution or runtime errors" (source severity MAJOR, mapped to high). anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rejected this in their notes: the guard at 22139-22141 short-circuits unless `pr_state` is closed or merged, and the helper at 22934-22951 returns 1 for empty or `{}` JSON.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Report state as merged when it merged." (from the Proposed fix section)
  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh
  confidence=2
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: The logic in `invoke_stall_judge` (lines 21768-21773) correctly sets `pr_state="merged"`, but the reviewer says the surrounding code and diagnostic reporting still rely on the REST `.state`, which returns `closed` for merged PRs (source severity NIT). anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rejected this in their notes: `pr_state` is rewritten from `.merged`/`.merged_at` (21766-21773) before both jq builders (21882-21947) consume it.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
(No findings reported.)
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:22143 | HARDENING_SUGGESTION (not a finding) | HARDENING_RISK_SCORE=1
  PROBLEM: In invoke_stall_judge, `head_ref` from the PR's REST payload goes into the "escalate_human kept" ::notice:: line without sanitising. The STALL_SKIP line at 23635 sanitises with `_close_sweep_log_ref`.
  WHY: Consistency only, because Git refnames cannot contain newlines or control characters, so no workflow command can be injected. Suggested fix: replace (head=${head_ref:-unknown}) with (head=$(_close_sweep_log_ref "${head_ref}" "unknown")), 1 line.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:22139 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The condition checking `_pr_json_is_issue_implementation_pr` uses `linked_pr_json`, which is only populated if the `target_pr` loop successfully fetched it in lines 21762-21764.
  WHY: If `target_pr` is empty or the fetch fails (e.g., due to an invalid or unreachable PR ID), `linked_pr_json` will be empty, which could lead to incorrect resolution or runtime errors when `_pr_json_is_issue_implementation_pr` is evaluated.
- TASK_GAP | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  Requirement: "Report state as merged when it merged." (from the Proposed fix section)
  Expected change site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh
  Evidence of absence: The logic in `invoke_stall_judge` (lines 21768-21773) correctly sets `pr_state="merged"`, but the surrounding code and diagnostic reporting still rely on the REST `.state` (which returns `closed` for merged PRs). This may lead to diagnostics reporting a merged PR as `closed` in some contexts.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

  WHY: Safe today because the flag is read only right after the reconcile call, which resets it on entry. Suggested fix: add `_STALL_STANDALONE_NT_SKIP_LOGGED=false` next to the existing `_std_prefetched_impl_pr_num=""` loop reset, 1 line.
